name: Dustwind Cave
summary: Burning Blade initiates train in Dustwind Cave, high above Razorwind Canyon northeast of Razor Hill. The cave is both a training ground and a covert refuge for the cult in Durotar.

sections.title: A Shadow in the Cliffs
sections.body: Dustwind Cave overlooks Razorwind Canyon, close to Razor Hill and a perilous threat to the town. The Burning Blade trains new recruits here beneath the notice of Horde authorities. Cultists teach initiates forbidden dark magic and demonology, preparing them to undermine the young orcish realm from within Durotar's borders.

sections.title: Tainted Bloodlines
sections.body: Those who enter Dustwind Cave risk the Burning Blade's corruptions. Cultists channel volatile dark arts, including felblood afflictions. Their work shows how firmly the cult holds to the demonic legacy Thrall fought to banish. Clearing the cabal from the cave matters to Durotar's fragile peace.

faq.answer: Dustwind Cave lies high on the clifftops of Razorwind Canyon, directly northeast of Razor Hill in Durotar.
Cultists and initiates of the Burning Blade occupy Dustwind Cave. The shadowy demonic cult spreads fel corruption and seeks to destabilize the Horde.

faq.q: Why is the Burning Blade operating here?
aliases: why are cultists in dustwind cave
faq.answer: The Burning Blade uses Dustwind Cave as a secluded training outpost. Seasoned cultists teach new recruits demonic arts away from the immediate gaze of guards in Orgrimmar and Razor Hill.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want this cave cleared?
faq.answer: Demon-worshiping cultists near Razor Hill threaten the safety of traveling recruits and Durotar's defenses.

angles.text: As a Horde warlock, you may recognize the dark rituals in Dustwind Cave. The Burning Blade turns its fel gifts toward rebellion against Thrall's new order.
For the Horde, Dustwind Cave is a dangerous breach within your borders, sheltering demon cultists within shouting distance of Razor Hill.
